data.one_liner: Translate IANA time‑zone IDs to ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 country codes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a static method to get a country code from a time‑zone string and an async method to get the device's local country code. It uses the timezone and flutter_timezone packages and bundles the IANA database version.
use_when: You need a quick mapping from time‑zone identifiers to country codes without writing your own lookup table
You want a pure‑Dart solution that works on mobile, web and desktop
avoid_when: You require up‑to‑date time‑zone data beyond the bundled version
You need full locale or language information, not just the country code
strengths: Bundled IANA data ensures consistent results
weaknesses: Country code may be ambiguous for some zones (e.g., multiple countries share a zone)
Relies on the packaged IANA version, which may become outdated
data.minimal_example:
String code = await TimeZoneToCountry.getLocalCountryCode();
print(code); // e.g., 'KR'
